This '''national electoral calendar for 2010''' lists the national/[[Federation|federal]] elections held in 2010 in all [[List of sovereign states|sovereign states]] and their [[Dependent territory|dependent territories]]. [[By-election]]s are excluded, though national [[referendum]]s are included.{{Elections}}

==January==
* 10 January: [[Elections in Croatia|Croatia]], [[Croatian presidential election, 2009–2010|President (2nd round)]]
* 17 January:
** [[Elections in Chile|Chile]], [[2009–10 Chilean presidential election|President (2nd round)]]
** [[Elections in Ukraine|Ukraine]], [[2010 Ukrainian presidential election|President (1st round)]]
* 22 January: [[Elections in the Netherlands Antilles|Netherlands Antilles]], [[2010 Netherlands Antilles general election|Parliament]]
* 25 January: [[Elections in Saint Kitts and Nevis|Saint Kitts and Nevis]], [[2010 Saint Kitts and Nevis general election|Parliament]]
* 26 January: [[Elections in Sri Lanka|Sri Lanka]], [[2010 Sri Lankan presidential election|President]]

==February==
* 3 February: [[Elections in Greece|Greece]], [[2010 Greek presidential election|President]] (by the parliament)
* 7 February:
** [[Elections in Costa Rica|Costa Rica]], [[2010 Costa Rican general election|President and Parliament]]
** [[Elections in Ukraine|Ukraine]], [[2010 Ukrainian presidential election|President (2nd round)]]
* 15 February: [[Elections in Anguilla|Anguilla]], [[2010 Anguillan general election|Parliament]]
* 27 February: [[Elections in Nauru|Nauru]], [[2010 Nauruan constitutional referendum|Constitutional referendum]]
* 28 February: [[Elections in Tajikistan|Tajikistan]], [[2010 Tajikistani parliamentary election|Parliament]]

==March==
* 4 March: [[Elections in Togo|Togo]], [[2010 Togolese presidential election|President]]
* 6 March: [[Elections in Iceland|Iceland]], [[2010 Icelandic Icesave referendum|Debt repayment referendum]]
* 7 March:
** [[Elections in Iraq|Iraq]], [[2010 Iraqi parliamentary election|Parliament]] 
** [[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[March 2010 Swiss referendum|Referendum]]
* 14 March: [[Elections in Colombia|Colombia]], [[2010 Colombian legislative election|Parliament]]

==April==
* 8 April: [[Elections in Sri Lanka|Sri Lanka]], [[2010 Sri Lankan parliamentary election|Parliament (1st round)]]
* 11 April: [[Elections in Hungary|Hungary]], [[2010 Hungarian parliamentary election|Parliament (1st round)]]
* 11–15 April: [[Elections in Sudan|Sudan]], [[2010 Sudanese general election|President and Parliament]]
* 18 April: [[Elections in Northern Cyprus|Northern Cyprus]], [[2010 Northern Cyprus presidential election|President]]
* 20 April: [[Elections in Sri Lanka|Sri Lanka]], [[2010 Sri Lankan parliamentary election|Parliament (2nd round)]]
* 24 April: [[Elections in Nauru|Nauru]], [[April 2010 Nauruan parliamentary election|Parliament]] 
* 25 April:
** [[Elections in Austria|Austria]], [[2010 Austrian presidential election|President]]
** [[Elections in Hungary|Hungary]], [[2010 Hungarian parliamentary election|Parliament (2nd round)]]

==May==
* 5 May: [[Elections in Mauritius|Mauritius]], [[2010 Mauritian general election|Parliament]]
* 6 May: [[Elections in the United Kingdom|United Kingdom]], [[2010 United Kingdom general election|Parliament]]
* 10 May: [[Elections in the Philippines|Philippines]], [[2010 Philippine presidential election|President]], [[2010 Philippine House of Representatives elections|House of Representatives]], [[2010 Philippine Senate election|Senate]] (one half)
* 16 May: [[Elections in the Dominican Republic|Dominican Republic]], [[2010 Dominican Republic parliamentary election|Parliament]]
* 23 May:
** [[Elections in Ethiopia|Ethiopia]], [[2010 Ethiopian general election|Parliament]]
** [[Elections in Nagorno-Karabakh|Nagorno-Karabakh]], [[2010 Nagorno-Karabakh parliamentary election|Parliament]]
* 24 May: [[Elections in Trinidad and Tobago|Trinidad and Tobago]], [[2010 Trinidad and Tobago general election|Parliament]]
* 25 May: [[Elections in Suriname|Suriname]], [[2010 Surinamese legislative election|Parliament]]
* 28–29 May: [[Elections in the Czech Republic|Czech Republic]], [[2010 Czech legislative election|Parliament]]
* 30 May: [[Elections in Colombia|Colombia]], [[2010 Colombian presidential election|President (1st round)]]

==June==
* 1 and 8 June: [[Elections in Egypt|Egypt]], [[2010 Egyptian Shura Council election|Shura Council]]
* 6 June: [[Elections in Slovenia|Slovenia]], [[2010 Slovenian border dispute agreement referendum|Border dispute agreement referendum]]
* 9 June: [[Elections in the Netherlands|Netherlands]], [[2010 Dutch general election|Parliament]]
* 12 June: [[Elections in Slovakia|Slovakia]], [[2010 Slovak parliamentary election|Parliament]]
* 13 June: [[Elections in Belgium|Belgium]], [[2010 Belgian general election|Parliament]]
* 19 June: [[Elections in Nauru|Nauru]], [[June 2010 Nauruan parliamentary election|Parliament]]
* 20 June:
** [[Elections in Colombia|Colombia]], [[2010 Colombian presidential election|President (2nd round)]]
** [[Elections in Poland|Poland]], [[2010 Polish presidential election|President (1st round)]]
* 26 June: [[Elections in Somaliland|Somaliland]], [[2010 Somaliland presidential election|President]]
* 27 June:
** [[Elections in Guinea|Guinea]], [[2010 Guinean presidential election|President (1st round)]]
** [[Elections in Kyrgyzstan|Kyrgyzstan]], [[2010 Kyrgyzstani constitutional referendum|Constitutional referendum]]
* 28 June: [[Elections in Burundi|Burundi]], [[2010 Burundian presidential election|President]]
* 29 June: [[Elections in Hungary|Hungary]], [[2010 Hungarian presidential election|President]] (indirect)
* 30 June: [[Elections in Germany|Germany]], [[2010 German presidential election|President]] (indirect)

==July==
* 4 July: [[Elections in Poland|Poland]], [[2010 Polish presidential election|President (2nd round)]]
* 11 July: [[Elections in Japan|Japan]], [[2010 Japanese House of Councillors election|House of Councillors]]
* 19 July: [[Elections in Suriname|Suriname]], [[2010 Surinamese presidential election|President]] (indirect)
* 23 July: [[Elections in Burundi|Burundi]], [[2010 Burundian legislative election|National Assembly]]
* 28 July: [[Elections in Burundi|Burundi]], [[2010 Burundian Senate election|Senate]] (indirect)

==August==
* 1 August: [[Elections in São Tomé and Príncipe|São Tomé and Príncipe]], [[2010 São Tomé and Príncipe legislative election|Parliament]]
* 4 August:
** [[Elections in Kenya|Kenya]], [[2010 Kenyan constitutional referendum|Constitutional referendum]]
** [[Elections in the Solomon Islands|Solomon Islands]], [[2010 Solomon Islands general election|Parliament]]
* 9 August: [[Elections in Rwanda|Rwanda]], [[2010 Rwandan presidential election|President]]
* 21 August: [[Elections in Australia|Australia]], [[2010 Australian federal election|Parliament]]

==September==
* 5 September: [[Elections in Moldova|Moldova]], [[2010 Moldovan constitutional referendum|Constitutional referendum]]
* 12 September: [[Elections in Turkey|Turkey]], [[2010 Turkish constitutional referendum|Constitutional referendum]]
* 16 September: [[Elections in Tuvalu|Tuvalu]], [[2010 Tuvaluan general election|Parliament]]
* 17 September: [[Elections in Sint Maarten|Sint Maarten]], [[2010 Sint Maarten general election|Parliament]]
* 18 September:
** [[Elections in Afghanistan|Afghanistan]], [[2010 Afghan parliamentary election|Parliament]]
** [[Elections in Slovakia|Slovakia]], [[2010 Slovak political reform referendum|Political reform referendum]]
* 19 September: [[Elections in Sweden|Sweden]], [[2010 Swedish general election|General]]
* 22 September: [[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[2010 Swiss Federal Council election|Federal Council]] (indirect)
* 26 September:
** [[Elections in Venezuela|Venezuela]], [[2010 Venezuelan parliamentary election|Parliament]]
** [[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[September 2010 Swiss referendum|Referendum]]

==October==
* 2 October: [[Elections in Latvia|Latvia]], [[2010 Latvian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
* 3 October:
** [[Elections in Brazil|Brazil]], [[2010 Brazilian presidential election|President (1st round)]] and [[2010 Brazilian general election|Parliament]]
** [[Elections in Bosnia and Herzegovina|Bosnia and Herzegovina]], [[2010 Bosnia and Herzegovina general election|President and Parliament]]
* 10 October: [[Elections in Kyrgyzstan|Kyrgyzstan]], [[2010 Kyrgyzstani parliamentary election|Parliament]]
* 15–16 October: [[Elections in the Czech Republic|Czech Republic]], [[2010 Czech Senate election|Senate (1st round)]] (a third)
* 22–23 October: [[Elections in the Czech Republic|Czech Republic]], [[2010 Czech Senate election|Senate (2nd round)]] (a third) 
* 23 October: [[Elections in Bahrain|Bahrain]], [[2010 Bahraini general election|Parliament (1st round)]] 
* 30 October: [[Elections in Bahrain|Bahrain]], [[2010 Bahraini general election|Parliament (2nd round)]] 
* 31 October:
** [[Elections in Brazil|Brazil]], [[2010 Brazilian presidential election|President (2nd round)]]
** [[Elections in Côte d'Ivoire|Côte d'Ivoire]], [[2010 Ivorian presidential election|President (1st round)]] 
** [[Elections in Niger|Niger]], [[2010 Nigerien constitutional referendum|Constitutional referendum]]
** [[Elections in Tanzania|Tanzania]], [[2010 Tanzanian general election|President and Parliament]]

==November==
* 1 November: [[Elections in Nauru|Nauru]], [[2010 Nauruan presidential election|President]] (indirect)
* 2 November:
** [[2010 United States elections|United States]], [[2010 United States House of Representatives elections|House of Representatives]] and [[2010 United States Senate elections|Senate]] (one third: Class 3 senators)
** [[Elections in American Samoa|American Samoa]], [[2010 American Samoan general election|Parliament]] and [[2010 American Samoa constitutional referendum|Constitutional referendum]]  
**''[[Elections in Guam|Guam]], [[2010 Guamanian gubernatorial election|Governor]], [[2010 Guamanian general election#Attorney General|Attorney General]], [[2010 Guamanian general election#Consolidated Commission on Utilities|Consolidated Commission on Utilities]], [[2010 Guamanian general election|Parliament]], and [[2010 Guamanian general election#Judicial retention election|Supreme Court and Superior Court retention elections]]''<ref>{{cite web|url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/13AMz_QrX98O1cEQcVRnf9iyM5jB9QErK/view|title=2010 Election Comparative Analysis Report|publisher=Guam Election Commission|date=18 January 2012|access-date=6 August 2020}}</ref>
** [[Elections in the U.S. Virgin Islands|United States Virgin Islands]], [[2010 United States Virgin Islands gubernatorial election|Governor]] and [[2010 United States Virgin Islands general election|Parliament]]
* 7 November:
** [[Elections in the Comoros|Comoros]], [[2010 Comorian presidential election|President (1st round Mohéli primary)]] 
** [[Elections in Burma|Burma (Myanmar)]], [[2010 Burmese general election|General]] 
** [[Elections in Azerbaijan|Azerbaijan]], [[2010 Azerbaijani parliamentary election|Parliament]]
** [[Elections in Guinea|Guinea]], [[2010 Guinean presidential election|President (2nd round)]]
* 9 November: [[Elections in Jordan|Jordan]], [[2010 Jordanian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
* 17 November:
** [[Elections in the Cook Islands|Cook Islands]], [[2010 Cook Islands general election|Parliament]] and [[2010 Cook Islands MP reduction referendum|referendum]]
** [[Elections in Madagascar|Madagascar]], [[2010 Malagasy constitutional referendum|Constitutional referendum]] 
* 21 November: [[Elections in Burkina Faso|Burkina Faso]], [[2010 Burkinabé presidential election|President]]
* 25 November: [[Elections in Tonga|Tonga]], [[2010 Tongan general election|General]]
* 27 November: [[Elections in Iceland|Iceland]], [[2010 Icelandic Constitutional Assembly election|Constitutional Assembly]]
* 28 November:
** [[Elections in Côte d'Ivoire|Côte d'Ivoire]], [[2010 Ivorian presidential election|President (2nd round)]] 
** [[Elections in Moldova|Moldova]], [[2010 Moldovan parliamentary election|Parliament]]
** [[Elections in Haiti|Haiti]], [[Haitian general election, 2010–2011|Parliament and President (1st round)]]
** [[Elections in Egypt|Egypt]], [[2010 Egyptian parliamentary election|Parliament (1st round)]]

==December==
* 5 December: [[Elections in Egypt|Egypt]], [[2010 Egyptian parliamentary election|Parliament (2nd round)]]
* 12 December:
** [[Elections in Kosovo|Kosovo]], [[2010 Kosovan parliamentary election|Parliament]]
** [[Elections in Slovenia|Slovenia]], [[2010 Slovenian public broadcaster law referendum|Referendum]]
** [[Elections in Transnistria|Transnistria]], [[2010 Transnistrian legislative election|Parliament]]
* 13 December: [[Elections in Saint Vincent and the Grenadines|Saint Vincent and the Grenadines]], [[2010 Saint Vincent and the Grenadines general election|Parliament]]
* 19 December: [[Elections in Belarus|Belarus]], [[2010 Belarusian presidential election|President]]
* 26 December: [[Elections in the Comoros|Comoros]], [[2010 Comorian presidential election|President (2nd round nationwide)]]

==Indirect elections==
*20–22 January: [[Elections in Uzbekistan|Uzbekistan]], [[2010 Uzbek senatorial election|Senate]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://archive.ipu.org/parline-e/reports/arc/2344_10.htm|title=Uzbekistan Senat (Senate): Elections in 2010|publisher=[[Inter-Parliamentary Union]]|access-date=22 December 2020}}</ref>
*3 February: [[Elections in Greece|Greece]], [[2010 Greek presidential election|President]]
*20 February: [[Elections in Afghanistan|Afghanistan]], [[2010 Afghan House of Elders election|House of Elders]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://archive.ipu.org/parline-e/reports/arc/2382_10.htm|title=Afghanistan Meshrano Jirga (House of Elders): Elections in 2010|publisher=[[Inter-Parliamentary Union]]|access-date=23 December 2020}}</ref>
*15 March, 5 May and 21 June: ''[[Elections in the Isle of Man|Isle of Man]], [[2010 Manx Legislative Council election|Legislative Council]]''<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.isleofman.com/News/details/29232/try-again-for-legislative-council-election|title=Try again for Legislative Council election|work=[[Manx Radio]]|date=15 March 2010|access-date=22 December 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.isleofman.com/News/details/28175/still-no-result-in-mlc-election|title=Still no result in MLC election|work=[[Manx Radio]]|date=5 May 2010|access-date=22 December 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.energyfm.net/cms/news_story_106961.html|title=Alan Crowe re-elected to LegCo|work=[[Energy FM (Isle of Man)|Energy FM]]|date=21 June 2010|access-date=22 December 2020}}</ref>
*26 March and 14 June: [[Elections in India|India]], [[2010 Rajya Sabha elections|Council of States]]
*1 April: [[Elections in San Marino|San Marino]], [[Captains Regent]]
*23 April: [[Elections in Tajikistan|Tajikistan]], [[2010 Tajik National Assembly election|National Assembly]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://archive.ipu.org/parline-e/reports/2366.htm|title=Tajikistan: Majlisi milli (National Assembly)|publisher=[[Inter-Parliamentary Union]]|date=5 July 2016|access-date=22 December 2020}}</ref>
*21 May: [[Elections in Sudan|Sudan]], [[2010 Sudanese Council of States election|Council of States]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.gurtong.net/ECM/Editorial/tabid/124/ctl/ArticleView/mid/519/articleId/3628/E-Equatoria-Assembly-Elects-Council-of-States-Representatives.aspx|title=E. Equatoria State Elects Council of States Representatives|publisher=Gurtong Trust|date=24 May 2010|access-date=23 December 2020}}</ref>
*23 May: [[Elections in Ethiopia|Ethiopia]], [[2010 Ethiopian House of Federation election|House of Federation]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.iri.org/sites/default/files/Ethiopia%20Pre-Election%20Watch,%20May%202010%20Parliamentary%20Elections.pdf|title=Ethiopia Pre-Election Watch: May 2010 Parliamentary Elections|publisher=[[International Republican Institute]]|access-date=21 December 2020}}</ref>
*24 June, 21 October and 25 November: [[Elections in Austria|Austria]], [[2010 Austrian Federal Council elections|Federal Council]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.derstandard.at/story/1276413333685/neuer-burgenlaendischer-landtag-konstituiert-sich-am-24-juni|title=The new Burgenland Landtag is constituted on June 24th|work=[[Der Standard]]|language=de|date=17 June 2010|access-date=27 December 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.parlament.gv.at/PAKT/PR/JAHR_2010/PK0535/index.shtml|title=Federal Council: Three new representatives from Burgenland|publisher=Austrian Parliament|language=de|date=25 June 2010|access-date=27 December 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.landtag.steiermark.at/cms/ziel/122780382/DE/|title=Stenographic reports (XVI period): Meetings of the Styrian Parliament in 2010, 1st session of the Styrian Parliament on October 21, 2010|publisher=Office of the Styrian Provincial Government|language=de|access-date=27 December 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.wien.gv.at/mdb/ltg/2010/ltg-001-s-2010-11-25-001.htm|title=Parliament 19th legislative term, 1st meeting on November 25, 2010: Meeting report|publisher=City of Vienna|language=de|access-date=27 December 2020}}</ref>
*29 June: [[Elections in Hungary|Hungary]], [[2010 Hungarian presidential election|President]]
*19 July: [[Elections in Suriname|Suriname]], [[2010 Surinamese presidential election|President]]
*28 July: [[Elections in Burundi|Burundi]], [[2010 Burundian legislative election#Senate|Senate]]
*1 October: [[Elections in San Marino|San Marino]], [[Captains Regent]]
*1 November: [[Elections in Nauru|Nauru]], [[2010 Nauruan presidential election|President]]
*11 November: [[Elections in Iraq|Iraq]], [[2010 Iraqi government formation|President]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.dawn.com/news/909719/iraq-president-talabani-re-elected-despite-mps-walk-out|title=Iraq President Talabani re-elected despite MPs walk-out|work=[[Dawn (newspaper)|Dawn]]|date=12 November 2010|access-date=22 December 2020}}</ref>
*26–27 November: [[Elections in Namibia|Namibia]], [[2010 Namibian National Council election|National Council]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.senat.fr/senatsdumonde/english/namibie.html|title=THE NATIONAL COUNCIL OF NAMIBIA|publisher=Senate of France|access-date=21 December 2020}}</ref>
*3 December: [[Elections in Bosnia and Herzegovina|Bosnia and Herzegovina]], [[2010 Bosnian House of Peoples election|House of Peoples]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.glassrpske.com/lat/novosti/vijesti_dana/Kantoni-u-FBiH-blokirali-izbor-Doma-naroda-BiH/51552|title=Cantons in FBiH blocked the election of the House of Peoples of BiH|work=[[Glas Srpske]]|language=bs|date=11 January 2011|access-date=22 December 2020}}</ref>
